summary: Add tabindex/role/aria attributes to #cmp, update setSplit to set aria-valuenow, add keydown handler with preventDefault/cancelAnimationFrame/setSplit, update show() to set alt text, and add focus-visible outline to CSS.

replacements.replacement: <div class="cmp" id="cmp" style="--split: 50%" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Before/after comparison" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="50">
const setSplit = (v) => { const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v)); cmp.style.setProperty("--split", `${c}%`); cmp.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", Math.round(c)); };

replacements.search: cmp.addEventListener("pointerdown", (ev) => { dragging = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); cmp.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); fromPointer(ev); });
.cmp { position: relative; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; user-select: none; touch-action: pan-y; cursor: ew-resize; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
replacements.replacement:
.cmp { position: relative; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; user-select: none; touch-action: pan-y; cursor: ew-resize; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.cmp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }
